description: This PHP source file defines the ResetPasswordController class, which handles password reset requests in the OrangeHRM authentication module. It manages CSRF token validation, reset code validation, password updating, and session invalidation.

classes.name: ResetPasswordController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling password reset requests, validating tokens and reset codes, updating user passwords, and invalidating sessions.

methods.name: getResetPasswordService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of ResetPasswordService.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the password reset request, validating CSRF token, reset code, and username, then updating the password and invalidating the session.
